permissions.description: Create and maintain authorized academic offerings.
constraints: Publication and owning unit must be authorized.

permissions.description: Schedule, activate, close or archive an offering.
constraints: Check staffing, schedule, attempt impact and explicit state guards.

permissions.description: Publish schedule and per-audience date revisions.
constraints: Individual sensitive accommodations require separately delegated authority.

permissions.description: Approve or end enrollments and manage scoped rosters.
constraints: Section transfer requires authority to affected scopes.

permissions.description: Stage and apply a verified scoped roster feed.
Export an authorized scoped roster projection.
constraints: Apply purpose, audit and private download expiry.

permissions.description: Create and manage scoped learning groups or cohorts.
constraints: Institution cohort assignment requires institution scope.

permissions.description: Apply, accept a seat or cancel a personal application.
constraints: Person must match current principal unless allowed registrar route.

permissions.description: Use authorized learning surfaces and personal progress features.
constraints: Actions bind effective learner and enrollment release.

permissions.description: Approve and apply reviewed enrollment release mappings.
constraints: Separate curriculum version approval and protected existing attempt policy.
Validate exact source kind and version.
Record reason, approval and downstream impact.

permissions.description: Schedule meetings and confirm scoped attendance.
constraints: Confirmation does not imply correction authority.

permissions.description: Publish revised attendance outcome with reason.
constraints: Prior decision retained. Assess academic impact.

permissions.description: Publish scoped announcements and provider associations.
constraints: Authorized audience and integration account required.

permissions.description: Read scoped teacher participation and progress projections.
constraints: Applies separate field capabilities for sensitive data.

permissions.description: Grant or end an explicit educational gate waiver for an eligible learner.
constraints: Override cannot bypass safety, tenant, enrollment status, hard close or assessment approval.

permissions.description: Record and close learner support interventions.
constraints: Current teaching or registrar authority and restricted-note capability required.
Visible catalog context or owned prior preference. No enrollment needed.

scenarios.title: Last seat admits one learner
given: Capacity 20. 19 seats occupied. No reservations.
when: Two different eligible direct admission commands overlap.
then: Exactly one active enrollment and first release added. Losing request reports capacity conflict.

scenarios.title: Waitlist reservations hold seat across retries
given: One eligible waitlisted learner and one unreserved seat.
when: Issue 48-hour hold. Retry accept after successful commit.
then: Original enrollment and release IDs returned. Capacity consumed once.

scenarios.title: Full feed preserves independent grants
given: Person P has direct and source S grants. Verified complete S feed omits P.
when: Apply full feed with explicit revocation.
then: Only S grant ends. Stable enrollment remains active.

scenarios.title: Missing partial feed cannot revoke
given: Full feed fails row validation and coverage incomplete.
when: Attempt apply with unseen grant revocation.
then: No unseen grant ends. Report actionable diagnostics.

scenarios.title: Transfer preserves historical attempt
given: Learner has an active exam pinned to Section A dates.
when: Move learner from A to B and close A-only learning group membership.
then: Same enrollment and release remain. New starts use B. Old attempt policy remains pinned.

scenarios.title: Precedence applies fields independently
given: Default due November 14 at 17:00. Section B sets November 15 at 12:00. Group sets recommended date only.
when: Learner override sets due November 15 at 18:00.
then: Effective due 18:00. Group recommendation retained. Hard close unchanged.

scenarios.title: Same group precedence conflicts fail closed
given: Two simultaneously applicable groups rank 10 and set unequal due dates.
when: Try to add second override.
then: Reject 422 SCHEDULE_WINDOW_CONFLICT. Existing invalid legacy state denies new starts.

scenarios.title: Course release waits for in-progress exam
given: 30 learner releases use version 4. One learner has active exam.
when: Approve version 5 rollout and apply. Retry deferred learner after submission.
then: 29 change immediately. Last changes once after terminal attempt. Attempt remains on version 4.

scenarios.title: Video coverage merges intervals
given: Duration 100000 ms and threshold 90 percent.
then: Distinct coverage 89000 ms. Not complete.

scenarios.title: Late package evidence keeps old lineage
given: Package registration started on release R1. R2 is now effective.
when: Receive trusted committed package event for R1.
then: Evidence recorded on R1. R2 changes only if approved carry allows it.

scenarios.title: Attendance denominator excludes cancelled and excused
given: 12 required occurrences including one cancelled and one excused.
when: Publish two absent, one late and seven present.
then: Eight attended of ten eligible, 80 percent.

scenarios.title: Provider outage blocks remote launch only
given: Offering active while provider is unavailable.
when: Create group room and request launch.
then: Retryable pending or degraded provider state. Learning and academic records remain accessible.

scenarios.title: Stale resume does not overwrite newer session
given: Browser B accepted server resume revision 12. Offline browser A retains revision 11.
when: A reconnects and saves expected revision 11.
then: 409 REVISION_CHANGED. Revision 12 remains. Offer local checkpoint as explicit choice.

scenarios.title: Attendance correction appends before reviewing impact
given: An attendance decision contributed to awarded completion.
when: Publish correction and open academic impact review.
then: Old decision and completion remain auditable. Any completion change creates authorized supersession.

scenarios.title: Offering setup and safe activation
given: Published Algebra version 4 and academic period 2027-T1 are available.
when: Create ALG-2027-T1 with capacity 60. Add Sections A and B with capacity 30 and scoped instructors. Update B to capacity 32 while empty. Set offering capacity 62 and publish validated calendar and manual or self admissions. Schedule and activate.
then: Offering activates under exact version 4 and calendar revision 1. Sections retain independent caps. A second attempt to activate without a teacher returns OFFERING_NOT_READY.

scenarios.title: New offering default affects future enrollments
given: Learners A and B use version 4. Offering version 5 was independently published.
when: Set version 5 as default and admit learner C.
then: C receives version 5. A and B keep their version 4 releases and exact progress.

scenarios.title: Institution cohort and section-bound group remain distinct
given: Student P is in institution I and Section B of offering O.
when: Create cohort 2027 and add P. Create Section A group Debate and try adding P. Transfer P into Section A and add P to Debate, then close Debate.
then: Cohort membership gives no offering access. First group add fails scoped section check. Second succeeds. Closure preserves ended interval and the institutional cohort.

scenarios.title: Application denial and waitlist cancellation remain distinct
given: Offering requires approval and currently has no unreserved seat.
when: Learner P applies with verified prerequisites. Registrar waitlists P. P cancels. Learner Q applies and authorized registrar declines with a safe reason.
then: P ends cancelled and Q declined. Neither creates enrollment. Applicant projections expose only own decision and next action.

scenarios.title: Suspension and reactivation preserve work
given: Enrollment has release R4, two submissions and active collaboration.
when: Suspend for approved reason. Request new start. Reactivate with keep release option.
then: Ordinary start denied during suspension. Resume restores same Enrollment and R4. Work retained and provider removal or addition tracked separately.

scenarios.title: Acknowledgment, bookmarks and dashboard are separate
given: Learner P sees required reading R and optional practice B.
when: Bookmark R with label Review before exam, acknowledge R twice with the same intent, read dashboard and remove bookmark.
then: One accepted evidence. Dashboard advances to next actionable required item. Bookmark removal changes no progress. Staff do not see the label.

scenarios.title: Meeting reschedule and check-in retain stable occurrence
given: Teacher owns Section B and a weekly online tutorial at Tuesday 10:00.
when: Schedule series with first recurrence, move that occurrence to 11:00, open window 10:50–11:10, then check in at 10:55 twice with the same intent.
then: Same occurrence UID and higher sequence. One proposed attendance revision, no published decision.

scenarios.title: Scoped announcement edit and withdrawal
given: Teacher assigned Section B only. B contains learners P and Q.
when: Publish Section B announcement Quiz review moved to Friday. Transfer Q out of B. Attempt to publish another revision and withdraw it.
then: Dispatch snapshots exact authorized audience each time. Q receives no future dispatch and has no subsequent in-app B content access. Withdrawal suppresses queued attempts.

scenarios.title: Teacher workspace and roster export respect effective scope
given: Section A has 30 learners and Section B has 24. Teacher owns B with a separate export grant.
when: Read workspace and request B CSV. Try to export A.
then: Projection count 24 before later roster changes. A export is inaccessible. B artifact contains only allowed fields and default expiry 24 hours.

scenarios.title: Stale provider reconciliation cannot restore old access
given: Link desired revision 4 included learner P. Withdrawal generated revision 5 excluding P.
when: Receive delayed revision 4 provider success then verified revision 5 removal.
then: Old receipt cannot advance current state or authorize launch. Current removal receipt settles the new revision.

scenarios.title: Invitation token belongs to one verified learner
given: Registrar invites learner P for Section B. No capacity is reserved.
when: Learner Q attempts use. Registrar revokes unused invitation. P follows expired link.
then: Q receives generic unavailable response. Revocation leaves no application or seat consumed. P sees authorized unavailable status.

scenarios.title: Follow and application hold preserve separate scopes
given: Catalog visible to P. Registrar opens an offering-specific hold with safe next action.
when: P follows course and then applies. Registrar ends hold and P retries under current policy.
then: Follow succeeds without admission. First application cannot admit. Later eligibility re-evaluates without reassigning identity.

scenarios.title: Sticky unlock cannot override current safety blocks
given: Learner has reviewed prior-learning approval and activity explicitly has sticky continuity.
when: Authorized teacher grants clause approval. Learner opens activity, approval later ends, then institution withdraws unsafe asset.
then: First start pins eligible sticky decision. Routine gate end follows sticky policy. Safety block prevents new delivery, with original decision retained.

scenarios.title: Intervention remains separate from outcome change
given: Teacher owns learner P and a required task is overdue.
when: Record support reminder with approved purpose and mark completed when learner responds.
then: Support log advances. Required deadline and academic completion remain unchanged absent explicit separate authoritative mutations.
